name: use-hover
title: useHover
description: Custom hook that tracks whether a DOM element is being hovered over. ```tsx const buttonRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null); const isHovered = useHover(buttonRef); // Access the isHovered variable to determine if the button is being hovered over. ```

tags.template: - The type of the DOM element. Defaults to `HTMLElement`.

parameters.name: elementRef
parameters.description: - The ref object for the DOM element to track.

returnType.name: boolean
returnType.description: A boolean value indicating whether the element is being hovered over.
